svg.title: sparse-moba
svg.desc: MoBA on a toy 32-token grid with 8 blocks of 4: each query block reads its own block causally plus the top-2 past blocks by q times the mean key. Gate for the last block: scores per past block with blocks 2 and 4 selected. Mean pooling can hide a single sharp key: block X with one score of 3.6 averages 0.55, below block Y at 0.95; max pooling (MSA) would pick X. Real settings: block 512 top-3 at 8K reads 18.75%; block 4,096 top-12 at 1M reads 4.69%. Reported 6.5× prefill at 1M; RULER 128K 0.7818 versus 0.7849 for full attention.
